_meta.description: Curated clinical rules used by the claims engine. Every rule carries a public reference (peer-reviewed literature via PubMed or a regulatory label). Thresholds marked 'heuristic' are NuvoVet choices pending DVM advisory review.
_meta.review_status: unreviewed — DVM clinical pharmacologist sign-off required before production use

species_rules.title: 고양이 아세트아미노펜 처방
species_rules.detail: Acetaminophen is a frequent cause of poisoning in cats, producing methemoglobinemia and hepatic failure. A claim billing acetaminophen for a cat is clinically implausible or a coding error.
refs: Rumbeiha WK et al. Am J Vet Res 1995;56:1529-33. PMID 8585668

species_rules.title: 고양이 퍼메트린 제제
species_rules.detail: Permethrin intoxication in cats typically follows application of canine spot-on products. Billing permethrin as treatment for a cat suggests a coding error or a toxicosis claim mislabelled as treatment.
refs: Ceccherini G et al. Open Vet J 2015;5:113-21. PMID 26623376

species_rules.title: 고양이 브롬화물 항경련제
species_rules.detail: Bromide was associated with adverse effects in 8 of 16 treated cats (coughing in 6), and routine use in cats is not recommended.
refs: Boothe DM et al. J Am Vet Med Assoc 2002;221:1131-5. doi:10.2460/javma.2002.221.1131

species_rules.title: 고양이 엔로플록사신 고용량
species_rules.detail: Fluoroquinolone-induced retinal degeneration in cats is dose-related; the approved feline dose of enrofloxacin is 5 mg/kg/day.
refs: Wiebe V, Hamilton P. J Am Vet Med Assoc 2002;221:1568-71. doi:10.2460/javma.2002.221.1568
US FDA-approved Baytril (enrofloxacin) label — cats: 5 mg/kg/day

species_rules.title: 고양이 멜록시캄 반복 투여 용량
species_rules.detail: For repeated oral use in cats the EU-authorised maintenance dose is 0.05 mg/kg once daily after a 0.1 mg/kg first day; the US label carries a boxed warning against repeated dosing because of acute renal failure.
refs: EMA Metacam EPAR, product information — cats
US FDA Metacam injection label, boxed warning

species_rules.title: MDR1 위험 품종 이버멕틴 고용량
species_rules.detail: Herding breeds homozygous for the MDR1 (ABCB1-1Δ) deletion are highly sensitive to ivermectin neurotoxicity. Heartworm-preventive doses (~0.006 mg/kg) are tolerated; antiparasitic doses ≥0.05 mg/kg (heuristic threshold) require MDR1 genotyping.

combination_rules.title: NSAID + 코르티코스테로이드 병용
combination_rules.detail: Concurrent NSAID and corticosteroid administration was present in 59% of dogs with GI perforation on a COX-2 inhibitor; combined use without washout is a clinical-quality signal.
refs: Lascelles BD et al. J Am Vet Med Assoc 2005;227:1112-7. doi:10.2460/javma.2005.227.1112

combination_rules.title: NSAID 중복 처방
combination_rules.detail: Two NSAIDs in the same visit is therapeutic duplication; the same pharmacovigilance series links concurrent NSAIDs to GI perforation.
refs: Lascelles BD et al. J Am Vet Med Assoc 2005;227:1112-7. doi:10.2460/javma.2005.227.1112

chronic_marker_drugs._note: Drugs whose presence implies a chronic condition. If none of the claimed diagnoses explains the drug, the claim may be treating an undisclosed (possibly pre-existing) condition.
